content.text: In the current landscape, many creators in Zimbabwe face significant barriers due to restricted access to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-what-nobody-tells-4|payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal. These restrictions hinder your ability to monetize your digital creations effectively. However, by leveraging the Edge Commerce Stack, you can bypass these limitations and deploy a fully functional digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free. This step-by-step guide will walk you through the process, ensuring you maintain full ownership and control over your commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-6|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] without relying on conventional payment systems. It's time to take back your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-22|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce capabilities.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of mainstream payment platforms in Africa is a glaring issue for digital creators. These platforms often impose geographical restrictions, leaving you without viable options to receive payments. By using the Edge Commerce Stack, you establish a self-hosted digital store that operates independently of such external services. This infrastructure is resilient against payment processing failures because you control every component from the hosting to the backend logic. Additionally, using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions ensures you can accept a wide variety of digital currencies without the complications of traditional banking systems. This sovereignty not only protects your income but also enhances your market reach, allowing you to serve customers globally.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, ensure you have the necessary tools and accounts set up. First, create a GitHub account to host your store's front end using GitHub Pages. Next, sign up for Cloudflare to manage your domain and leverage their CDN for faster delivery. You’ll also need a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions seamlessly. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will serve as the backbone of your store for order processing and delivery. Lastly, ensure you have a digital wallet set up to receive crypto payments. With these essentials in place, you're ready to deploy your digital store efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment processing pipeline using NOWPayments. Navigate to your NOWPayments account and set up the necessary API keys for integration. Next, create a Google Apps Script project to handle incoming payment requests and to automate order processing. This involves writing scripts that verify payments and send out digital products upon successful transactions. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your digital products and ensure they are easily accessible. Integrating these components allows for automated delivery, enhancing the customer experience and streamlining your operations. Make sure to thoroughly test this pipeline before making your store live.
Take control of your digital commerce with sovereign infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything set up, it’s time to go live. Deploy your front end on GitHub Pages, ensuring all files are correctly linked and accessible. Once live, test the payment flow by making a small test purchase using a cryptocurrency of your choice through NOWPayments. Confirm that your integration between Google Apps Script and NOWPayments is functioning as intended by checking for payment confirmation and product delivery. This initial transaction will validate your setup and allow you to identify any possible issues before you start promoting your store. Remember, effective promotion is crucial for attracting customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After launching your store and successfully processing transactions, consider strategies for scaling. Start by expanding your product offerings; add more digital products based on market demand. Use Supabase to manage customer data and order history, which will help you personalize marketing efforts. Additionally, take advantage of social media and online communities to promote your digital store. Building a robust online presence can significantly increase your visibility and sales. Monitor your store’s performance continuously and be prepared to iterate on your infrastructure as your needs evolve. This proactive approach will keep your business agile and responsive.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages without Stripe, utilize the Edge Commerce Stack. This infrastructure comprises GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend processing, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. Follow our step-by-step guide to set up your store, ensuring complete control and ownership over your digital commerce capabilities. With this setup, you can effectively serve customers worldwide, circumventing the limitations imposed by traditional payment platforms.
Bypass payment restrictions and empower your sales.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack, available for $197, offers you a comprehensive solution for building your digital store. This package includes everything needed for deployment on Cloudflare Pages, ensuring you maintain full sovereignty over your infrastructure. By investing in this stack, you empower your commerce journey beyond the restrictions of traditional payment platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account for hosting your store. 2. Sign up for Cloudflare to manage your domain. 3. Set up a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency transactions. 4. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend processing. 5. Create a digital wallet to receive your payments. 6. Write Google Apps Script code for payment verification and product delivery. 7. Store your products in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 8. Deploy your front end on GitHub Pages. 9. Conduct a test purchase to verify functionality. 10. Promote your store to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use any cryptocurrency with NOWPayments?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a variety of digital currencies from customers.
What if I need help after deployment?
You have access to a 30-day support period after deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, ensuring you can resolve any issues that may arise.
Is there a limit on the number of products I can sell?
No, you can scale your store by adding as many digital products as you want without any restrictions.
How often will I receive payments after a sale?
Payments are processed instantly through NOWPayments once a transaction is confirmed on-chain, allowing you to access your funds quickly.
Do I need to pay for server hosting?
No. With GitHub Pages, you can host your website for free, significantly reducing your operational costs.
Your store, your ownership. Build it right with Edge Commerce.
